# KAIA EAKIN
## Committed to
Redwood City
It has been an honor to represent Redwood City District 5 as your councilmember and Vice Mayor, and I respectfully ask for your vote for a second term.
When funding for our parks, ballfields, and recreational spaces was in doubt, I successfully worked to secure more than $5 million. As an advocate for thoughtful planning, I have been a leading voice in protecting our 20 miles of Bay Shoreline from the impacts of sea level rise.
If I am re-elected to a second term, I will continue working to make our roads, especially Woodside Road and El Camino, safer for all users. I will collaborate with other agencies to improve our transportation infrastructure, ensure housing for all levels of affordability and develop safer, clearer guidelines for e-bike usage, especially for teens and children. I will advocate for more unified guidelines on both street and sidewalk vendors to ensure that they operate safely and do not crowd the public right-of-way. I will continue to support community policing to improve public safety.
As a life-long Bay Area resident, born in Redwood City, I care deeply about its future. Thank you for your consideration.
— Kaia Eakin

Meet Kaia Eakin
## A Passionate Advocate for Redwood City’s Future
Kaia is a life-long Bay Area resident who was born in Redwood City and grew up on the Peninsula. She attended local public schools including Woodside High School in Redwood City. She graduated from College of Notre Dame in Belmont with a degree in English Literature and received a JD from U.C. Davis.

## Your Voice for Positive Change
01
### Local Roots
Kaia’s long-standing commitment to Redwood City allows her to understand and address the unique needs of District 5 residents effectively.
02
### Community Focused
Her campaign prioritizes community involvement, ensuring that every voice is heard in decision-making processes for a better Redwood City.
